Test & repair shop — workers carrying parts between stations

A test and repair shop where three transport workers carry parts between stations.

What to watch for

Parts flow left to right, diagnostics through tests to repair, and the triangles are the workers. Station spacing is the model's own distance matrix rather than an arrangement someone chose, so what you see is the geometry the simulation actually used.

Underneath

This is a real run of a real model, not a recording. The page fetched the trace (51 KB gzipped) and drew it through the same renderer the desktop animation application uses. Download it and open it there to lay it out yourself.

Read the model's source — the simulation is not modified to be animated; capture is a flag on a run.
